### A Call for Kindness and Mercy
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/call-kindness-and-mercy
Passage: Zechariah 7:1-14
Points:
- Returning Jewish exiles inquired whether they should continue commemorative fasts halfway through rebuilding the temple.
- God rebuked their inquiries because their fasting was performed for self-justification rather than devotion to Him.
- Zechariah reminded them that God rejects empty religious formalism without heartfelt obedience.
- True covenant faithfulness requires dispensing justice, showing compassion, and protecting the defenseless.
- Believers must learn from God's past discipline rather than repeating the callous mistakes of their ancestors.

### Bible Pathway - September 28
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-sept-28-2013.html
Passage: Zechariah 7:5
Points:
- God commanded Zechariah to question the underlying motives behind Israel's seventy years of fasting.
- Israel's outward acts of mourning were disregarded by the Lord because they were practiced for selfish reasons.
- Godly actions and religious observances are only honored by God when done with pure, godly motives.
- Spiritual disciplines such as fasting serve to deny worldly flesh and refocus our hearts toward the Lord.
- Meaningful fasting must center on drawing near to God through dedicated prayer and His Word.
